status.scope_reason: Synertrade sells a complete Source-to-Pay platform (Synertrade 5) that includes full Procure-to-Pay capabilities, covering dedicated accounts payable workflows like invoice management and reconciliation.
status.evidence: According to a company press release on Synertrade's official website, Synertrade completed a management-led buyout on March 31, 2026, to become a fully independent company, and French corporate registry filings note it moved its head office to Courbevoie on July 1, 2026.

claims.claim: The company reports that its Synertrade 5 Invoicing platform features auditable workflows with traceable actions and predefined approval paths.
The company reports that its platform, Synertrade 5, provides ready-to-use standard connectors for integration with leading enterprise tools alongside open REST APIs for custom connectivity.

Independent sources state that Synertrade's software provides integrations and connectors for large-scale enterprise environments, specifically supporting integrations with platforms such as SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, and Oracle systems.
claims.note: integrations with platforms such as SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, and Oracle systems

claims.claim: The company reports that its platform utilizes artificial intelligence for contract-approval recommendations and automated certificate document extraction, while its invoicing module automates two- and three-way matching to flag discrepancies.
The company reports that its platform supports 250 customers from various industries to drive their business strategies.
claims.corrected: The company reports that its platform supports 250 customers from various industries to drive their business strategies on Accelerate.

claims.claim: The company announced that the transmission system operator TransnetBW selected its procurement platform through an EU-wide tender process.
Former parent company Econocom disclosed that it recorded a goodwill impairment of €37 million on Synertrade for 2025 during its divestment process.
Synertrade announced it completed a management-led buyout on 31 March 2026, transitioning to an independent company backed by B2B software investors.

The company reports operating through 7 offices worldwide (with service teams and hubs explicitly located in France, Germany, Italy, the United States, and India) to support more than 150 client organizations and 400,000 connected users globally.

The company announced in May 2026 that it is opening its implementation model to system integrator partners to build a broader channel ecosystem while expanding its direct geographic presence in North America.
Independent evaluations released in 2026 place Synertrade S.A. among evaluated procurement technology providers specifically within the AP Automation/Invoice-to-Pay category.
claims.corrected: Independent evaluations released in 2026 place Synertrade S.A. among evaluated procurement technology providers specifically within the Source-to-Pay Suites category.

claims.claim: The company is included as an enterprise-grade cloud suite vendor within global Source-to-Pay analyst market frameworks published in 2026.

The company completed a management-led buyout transaction on March 31, 2026, establishing itself as an independent company backed by a consortium of private investors specializing in B2B software platforms.
claims.source: Synertrade Press Release (https://synertrade.com) and Spend Matters Vendor Directory (https://spendmatters.com)

claims.claim: The company was previously acquired by Econocom Group (via its subsidiary Digital Dimension) in August 2015, which initially bought a 90% stake and later increased its ownership to 100% in July 2019 before divesting the entity in 2026.
claims.source: Econocom 2020 Annual Report (https://labrador.cld.bz/Econocom-2020-annual-report/65/) and Econocom press release (https://econocom.com)
